privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.who: Agora is run by Endika Iglesias as a personal project. Questions or requests about your data: endika2@gmail.com.
privacy.what: So a group can propose, vote and split costs, we store: the agora's name, the names people choose for themselves, the text of proposals and comments, votes, any images uploaded, and the amounts recorded.
privacy.noAccounts: There are no accounts and no passwords, and no email address or phone number is asked for or stored. Each device keeps an opaque identifier of its own, not derived from the name and useless in another agora.
privacy.basis: Legitimate interest: running the board the group asked for. People choose their own names, and whoever adds somebody else stores only a label to identify them inside the agora, nothing more.
privacy.visible: Anyone holding the agora's link is in it: they see the names on the list, the proposals, the votes already revealed, the comments and the images. The link is the key, so share it only with the people who belong there. While a vote is open, other people's choices never leave the server.
privacy.supabase: Supabase — database and image storage. Region eu-west-2 (London, United Kingdom), covered by the European Commission's adequacy decision.
privacy.github: GitHub Pages — serves the app. Like any web server it logs the IP address of whoever downloads it. GitHub is in the United States, with the transfer covered by the Data Privacy Framework.
privacy.noAnalytics: There is no analytics, no tracking cookies, no advertising and no profiling. That is why this app never asks you about cookies: there are none to consent to.
privacy.retention: What is in an agora stays while the agora exists: it is a board that lives for months and the group comes back to it. Nothing is deleted automatically by age.
privacy.rights: You can access, correct and delete your data. Download: anyone in the agora can export it as Markdown or JSON from “Share the agora”. Delete: in that same section, “Delete the agora” really removes the rows and the images from the server, confirmed by typing the agora's name. If you would rather ask in writing, email endika2@gmail.com and you will get an answer within a month.
privacy.device: To work offline, the app keeps on your device a copy of the board, any votes and comments waiting to be sent, your device identifier, and the list of agoras you have visited. None of that leaves your phone, and it goes when you clear the site's data or use the clear-and-reload button.
